We’re developing artificial intelligence to recognise deer calls and distinguish animal sounds from the noise of the forest.

Carefully collected, labelled field recordings will help us train and test across changing weather and terrain. As our dataset grows, we’ll refine how Echo recognises a call and Chrono points you towards it.

TECHNOLOGYSkip the animation

Rifle

A shoulder-held firearm used for hunting. Its stock, barrel and optic bring together a steady hold and a clear view of the target.

Components

The optic, barrel and stock, shown separately. Each has a distinct role in how the rifle is held, aimed and used.

Optic

Magnifies distant detail and provides an aiming reference, helping the hunter observe and identify a target.

Barrel

Guides the projectile as it leaves the rifle. Its forward alignment defines the direction of the shot.

Stock

The point of contact between hunter and rifle. It supports the rifle against the shoulder and helps it feel stable in the hands.

Rifle

The optic, barrel and stock come together as one familiar tool. Each part contributes to how it is held, aimed and used in the field.

Our goal

More awareness.
Less distraction.

Our goal is to help hunters understand the sounds around them, without taking their attention away from the field. We’re developing Echo and Chrono to turn animal sounds into clear, quiet direction.

Follow our development and help shape what we build next.
